prs.title: CLOUDP-472112: mongocli om standby-clusters lag — report standby replication lag
prs.tierReason: Fast path: single linked eng ticket, single candidate PR implementing exactly the documented command
prs.summary: Adds mongocli ops-manager standby-clusters lag: fetches cluster_status_v1.bson from the same S3 prefix as the configured DR state file, decodes it via a mirrored wire-contract struct enforcing schemaVersion, and prints estimated data loss, per-shard pending apply (--shards, relayed not recomputed), and standby lag (EDL + ESTS-MCTS). NA/not-available-yet fill-ins keep output shape stable; -o json prints the full contract document and other -o values are rejected. Ships with unit tests, fake-S3 store tests, testcontainers-MinIO integration tests, and the generated command reference page.
